title: Cobblemon Adapted
description: This project is a adpated version of cobbleverse by LUMYVERSE to neoforge with some extra mods.
body:
# Cobblemon Adapted

**Cobblemon Adapted** is a modpack inspired by the Cobbleverse from Lumyverse 🌍, delivering a similar experience with some changes designed to make the gameplay more varied and engaging.

🔄 One of the main changes is the removal of the *Mobs Be Gone* mod, allowing for more challenges and interactions throughout the world.

✨ In addition, the modpack introduces new content that expands both combat and automation within the Cobblemon experience.

## 🆕 Added Mods

* ⚔️ *Cobblemon Armory* — adds weapons, armor, and themed equipment, enabling a more direct combat playstyle beyond traditional Pokémon battles
* ⚙️ *Create* — introduces rotational mechanical systems such as mills, gears, and automated production lines for resource processing
* 💾 *Applied Energistics 2* — allows the creation of a centralized digital storage system with fast access to thousands of items and automated crafting

🚀 The goal of the modpack is to provide a more complete journey, combining capture, exploration, combat, and automation into a single experience.
